stage1.title: Stage 1: macOS Local Link & Wi-Fi Physical Telemetry (L1/L2)

stage2.desc: Multi-resolver benchmark, enterprise split-horizon check, and macOS proxy state
stage2.congestedWarn: [WARN: Enterprise Local DNS Forwarder Congested] Local DNS resolution > 60ms while public DNS < 20ms

stage3.title: Stage 3: WAN Backbone & Visual Hop-by-Hop MTR (L3/L4)
stage3.desc: Continuous multi-path telemetry, per-hop latency jitter, ASN tagging, and bottleneck isolation

stage4.title: Stage 4: Bufferbloat & Loaded Latency (RPM Metric)
stage4.desc: Apple networkQuality protocol, idle vs loaded saturation delta, and router queue rating

stage4.notTested: No bufferbloat test data yet. Click above or run full diagnostics.

stage5.title: Stage 5: Transport & TLS Performance Benchmark (L4/L7)
stage5.desc: TCP 3-way handshake, TLS 1.3 negotiation, TTFB responsiveness, and Path MTU blackhole check
stage5.pmtuBlackholeAlert: [CRITICAL: PMTU Blackhole Detected] Intermediate router silently drops packets exceeding MTU without ICMP Fragmentation Needed
stage5.notTested: No transport handshake data yet. Click above or run full diagnostics.

history.title: Diagnostic Test History (10 Snapshots FIFO)
history.desc: Persists the last 10 full-stack test snapshots locally. Supports historical inspection, metric diff comparison, and targeted AI troubleshooting.

history.diffTitle: Snapshot vs Live Metric Comparison (Diff View)
history.diffDesc: Compare metric deltas between historical snapshot and live network state (green = improvement, red = regression)
